property_summary: In the correct contract, a call to sendMoney never reverts even when the external call fails (returns false), so the onlyOwner modifier is always passed through and the caller can always proceed; the buggy contract reverts on external failure, making sendMoney revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a regular transfer to make the sendMoney function revert if transfer fails, changing sendMoney's behavior so it no longer returns success result to caller.
